Brief Biography

I am currently a Post-doctoral Research Fellow at the Department of Computer Science, Hong Kong Baptist University, under the supervision of Dr. Jie Chen. I obtained my PhD from the same department in 2026 under the supervision of Dr. Jie Chen, Prof. Yike Guo, and Prof. Jiming Liu. Prior to joining HKBU, I worked as a Senior Algorithm Engineer at Bigo in Guangzhou from 2019 to 2021. I received my M.Eng. in Software Engineering from Sun Yat-sen University in 2019 and my B.Eng. in Computer Science and Technology from Xiamen University in 2017.
